title: DayFlow
description: Android daily task tracker app built in Java.
detailedDescription:
Plan. Train. Flow.

DayFlow is an Android workout planner and fitness timer built to make planning and completing workouts easier.

 Workout Management
Create, edit, and delete exercises. Configure sets, reps, countdown timers, and rest periods, and track exercise completion.

 Workout Timer
Start, pause, resume, and reset exercise timers. Automatic completion tracking and audio notifications help you stay focused on your workout.

 Date-Based Planning
Navigate between past, present, and future workout days. Today is highlighted, past workouts are read-only, and future workouts remain editable.

 Local Data Persistence
Workout data is stored locally in JSON, so your plans remain available after restarting the app without requiring an online account or server.

title: SIGN2SOUND
description: Multimodal Speech-to-Text/Sign-to-Text accessibility system. IEEE hackathon Top 7 nationally.
detailedDescription:
Bridging Communication Through AI

SIGN2SOUND is a multimodal accessibility system developed by CodeCrew to reduce communication barriers between speech users and sign language users. It combines real-time speech recognition and AI-powered sign language recognition in a unified interface.

Speech-to-Text
Uses Vosk for real-time, offline speech recognition. Spoken language is converted into readable live captions displayed through an OpenCV GUI with start and stop controls.

Sign-to-Text
Uses MediaPipe to extract skeletal keypoints and a PyTorch LSTM-based sequence model to recognize sign language gestures and convert them into text. Temporal prediction smoothing helps stabilize sign outputs.

Optional Sign-to-Speech
A modular text-to-speech extension can convert recognized sign text into audio without retraining the recognition model.

AI & Computer Vision
Combines MediaPipe landmark extraction, time-series deep learning, OpenCV visualization, and offline speech recognition. The system uses an Indian Sign Language skeletal-keypoint dataset and supports real-time webcam inference.

Unified Demonstration
The OpenCV interface brings together webcam-based sign recognition, speech transcription, stable sign predictions, and system status indicators. Both pipelines operate independently while demonstrating bidirectional accessibility.

Future Scope
Planned enhancements include continuous sentence-level sign recognition, support for additional sign languages, deeper Sign-to-Speech integration, and web or mobile deployment.

title: PulseFit
description: AI-powered diet planner web app using React, Node.js, and the Gemini API.
detailedDescription:
Smarter Nutrition Through AI

PulseFit is an AI-powered diet planning web application designed to help users create personalized nutrition plans with the assistance of generative AI.

AI-Powered Diet Planning
Uses the Gemini API to generate diet recommendations based on user-provided information and dietary goals, helping make nutrition planning more accessible and personalized.

Modern Web Interface
Built with React for a responsive, interactive frontend, with Tailwind CSS for styling and a clean user experience.

 Backend & Data Management
Uses Node.js and Express to handle backend operations, with PostgreSQL for structured data storage.

User & Application Security
Includes authentication-related functionality using JWT and password hashing with bcrypt, alongside rate limiting for backend protection.

Plan Export
Supports printing and exporting diet plans, making recommendations easier to reference outside the application.

Project Goal
Bring AI-assisted nutrition planning into a convenient web application that combines generative AI, full-stack development, and accessible plan management.
